subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Now it is even less enough.'”?
options: Responsibility can grow when people understand that their action affects someone they may never meet.
Clean energy became less abstract when students could watch it being made above their own classrooms.
The lesson made students understand that media literacy must grow as technology grows.
It made students notice growth, responsibility, and the quiet needs of living things.
